item.title: LIEN DANS NOTRE BIO LINK IN BIOMelissa Auf der Maur : BASS WOMB ...
item.description: LIEN DANS NOTRE BIO LINK IN BIOMelissa Auf der Maur : BASS WOMB ROOM+ Jessica MossSunday, January 17, 7GesùDoors: 7PM | Show: 8PMMelissa Auf der Maur donne vie à son projet « BASS WOMB ROOM » lors d’un spectacle multimédia, présenté en exclusivité pour une seule soirée au Gesù. Auf der Maur sera accompagnée sur scène par les musiciens Alex Crow et Betsey Wright pour interpréter des morceaux inspirés de son installation multimédia « BASS WOMB ROOM », actuellement exposée au Musée des beaux-arts de l'Ontario. Cette performance comprendra des titres tirés de ses albums solo ainsi que des morceaux de son récent album « 9’s 4-Track Demos and Field Recordings », le tout sur fond de projections des archives vidéo d’Auf der Maur.Melissa Auf der Maur brings her BASS WOMB ROOM to life with a stunning, one-night-only multimedia performance at Le Gesù. Auf der Maur will be joined onstage by musicians Alex Crow and Betsey Wright as they perform music inspired by her multimedia installation BASS WOMB ROOM currently on view at the AGO. Pulling from her catalog of solo albums and tracks from her recent album of 9’s 4-Track Demos and Field Recordings, set to a backdrop of projections from Auf der Maur's video archives.

item.title: NEW DROP! MELISSA AF DER MAR // AF DER MAR Following a trajector...
item.description: NEW DROP! MELISSA AF DER MAR // AF DER MAR Following a trajectory unexpectedly redirected by a single thrown bottle, alt-rock royalty Melissa Auf der Maur established an unmistakable presence anchoring two of the defining alternative-rock bands of the ‘9s: Hole and The Smashing Pumpkins. Putting her own name and creative vision at the centre, this record brings together a formidable circle of collaborators—including Josh Homme and Nick Oliveri (Queens of the Stone Age), James Iha (Smashing Pumpkins), John Stanier (Tomahawk), and Eric Erlandson (Hole).Co-produced with Chris Goss, muscular riffs and crunching production meet breathy vocals and towering choruses. It is a commanding statement from an artist defining the sound on her own terms.Never before pressed to wax and making its global vinyl debut on ODDWAX, it arrives as an ODDWAX Exclusive LP, pressed on a custom heavyweight Metallic Antique Copper Marble. Housed in a heavyweight, matte-laminate gatefold packed with custom luxe fibre die-cut inner sleeves and a curated double-sided art poster, featuring a custom individually hand-numbered ODDWAX holographic hype sticker. Strictly 1 of 5 copies worldwide. 1 per collector. Exclusively on ODDWAX.Access is live—Get yours now via the link in bio.@xmadmx X @oddwaxrecs

item.title: I first listened to @xmadmx Melissa Auf der Maur’s BASS WOMB R...
item.description: I first listened to @xmadmx Melissa Auf der Maur’s BASS WOMB ROOM on September 4, and I struggled to find the words for it, because it pulled me outside my usual way of listening, which is strange, since I thought my emotional relationship with music had already shown me every way it could move through me.It ended up being a journey into sound itself, how it travels, comes back to me, to us, and how we’re an active part ofthat constant movement too.We tend to imagine listening as an arrow, I guess, travelling from a point of origin to a final target, the listener, but sound doesn’t stop there. It’s more like walking through an empty Gothic church: you hear your footsteps on the floor, again from the walls, then from further away, and you can feel the sound in your own body too.At the museum, BASS WOMB ROOM is a pyramid of mirrors with videos playing in the middle, where the images bounce between the mirrors and you end up reflected with them, much like the sound of your footsteps in the church.And it all makes sense through the body, through the womb, especially when you think about why Melissa calls the bass “the mother of all instruments”.Our mother’s voice reaches us from within her, along with her heartbeat and those low frequencies we can already feel. We’re not even born yet.The record brings together seven unheard ’9s demos she recorded alone at home in Los Angeles, guitar, voice, bass, a dripping faucet, the click of her camera, “the quiet and private side of the girl who joined the big American major label rock band”, and eight new interludes produced by Alex Crow, connected by a heartbeat that represents boththe bass and “the womb we all come from.”BASS WOMB ROOM: My ’9s 4-Track Demos x Field Recordings is out now on Envision Records, digitally# and on a limited pink cassette, with the vinyl out December 4, on pre-order in black and limited Coloured Galaxy Translucent, my favourite, of course.@xmadmx @pitchperfect.pr @envisionmanagement#9s #analog #9sgrunge

item.title: #SSAWmagazine AW6In the great encyclopaedia of rock, her story s...
item.description: #SSAWmagazine AW6In the great encyclopaedia of rock, her story sounds like a distorted fairy tale: a young, flame-haired Canadian bass player, plucked out of obscurity to join Hole, the band fronted by Courtney Love, only weeks after the death of both her husband, Kurt Cobain, and Kristen Pfaff, the previous musician to have held the job. Melissa Auf der Maur stepped into a storm, which she weathered for five years, before leaving and spending a year as the bassist in Smashing Pumpkins. 5 years after one of the most intense creative eras in music, the Montreal-born artist returns with both a memoir and a photo book revealing her own viewpoint, exponentially expanded by an incredible body of work. As her memoir Even the Good Girls Will Cry reveals, she captured every single moment of her journey using the Nikon camera she carried with her at all times. While the text tells of her emotional journey, the monograph My ’9s Rock Photographs displays the vast archive of images collected over the last analogue decade in human existence. From her home in New York State, Auf der Maur looks back at an era and an archive which took almost a quarter century to process.-Melissa Auf der Maur in conversation with Nathalie FraserPhotography @jjennawestraaStyling @roxanedansetHair and make-up @christinecherbonnier @thewallgroupProduction @sashita_bonitaPhotography Assistant @kathydisco-Melissa wears @maisonvalentino by @alessandro_michele

item.title: CITY OF ANGELSghosts, the red lady, cameos and beautiful contrad...
item.description: CITY OF ANGELSghosts, the red lady, cameos and beautiful contradictions.LACMA: Celebrating My ’9s Rock Photographs in a sprawling Brutalist empire of art, hosted my conversation with fellow Celtic warrior goddess Shirley Manson. After crashing the museum’s ticketing site by selling out so quickly to passionate Angelenos, our one-hour conversation barely scratched the surface of the epic themes we explored: Analog Humans, Women of All Times, Gen X, Photography, and our band’s places in the glory and mess of it all…I want more. I want to go deeper with her, in honor of our collective memory, to infuse some light into this wild, unknown future being built around us (and the atrocious human behavior we are currently witnessing across the globe)…NPLANNED CAMEO by NMBER 1 Warrior Goddess Courtney Love (that’s right, I call you that, and you can kiss and tease my witchy Stevie Nicks ass my friend ha ha!) - on behalf of the global world, we apologize for how you were treated and we are all in agreement that “we all owe you and you are so beloved and so respected by anyone who fucking matters!”AmenXLos Angeles! You came out for us! Eternally grateful that, my wild, defining, coming into womanhood, chapter in your lights and hills, still connects me so deeply to you all.Thank you for coming out, supporting and WAITING IN THAT BOOK SIGNING LINE?!!Patience is a virtue. It has paid off for me ten folds, three decades later, thanks for waiting with me.xMxP.S. The Sunset Tower ghosts travelled through me during that visit, whispered notions of “pulse of desire is connected to the pain of death” do what you will, put that in your pipe and smoke it for those of you who listen to the voices on the other side ….!!!!Dream dress by @samanthapleet + @francescadimattioGlitter cinch by @electricfeathersofficialIsis pendant by Egypt via @nadiasomersetPro-photos by Kristin Burns @kristinburnsstudio
